entities.summary: Charles L. Evans is the former ninth president and chief executive officer of the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, serving from 2007 to 2023. In that capacity, he served on the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the Federal Reserve System's monetary policy-making body.
